 Print The latest episode of Bigg Boss 20 witnessed a major twist as Olympic medallist Mary Kom got evicted from the reality show, while television actor Manish Goel lost a lifeline. The episode, hosted by filmmaker Rohit Shetty in Salman Khan’s absence, bought significant changes to the game as the contestants continue to face the pressure of nominations and audience voting. Mary Kom’s eviction comes after she spent seven weeks inside the Bigg Boss house. The boxing champion was among the contestants nominated for eviction this week, alongside Uditi Singh, Amrapali Dubey, Manish Goel, Arishfa Khan, Love Gill and Kushal Tanwar, popularly known as Gullu. According to reports, Mary Kom received the fewest audience votes, bringing her journey on the show to an end. Mary Kom’s journey in Bigg Boss 20 comes to an end
 Mary Kom entered the reality show with an accomplished sporting career, having represented India internationally and won an Olympic bronze medal. Her presence brought a different dynamic to the house, where she navigated relationships, disagreements and the challenges of the game. Her journey also attracted attention following a conversation about Indian female athletes, including Sania Mirza and Saina Nehwal. A remark attributed to Mary Kom during the discussion drew criticism from viewers, prompting her team to issue a clarification and apology. The boxer’s reported eviction adds another twist to a season that has seen contestants lose lifelines instead of immediately leaving the competition after receiving fewer votes. Manish Goel loses a lifeline
 In another significant development, television actor Manish Goel lost a lifeline during the latest round of the competition. The actor, who entered the house as a wildcard contestant, was among the seven housemates nominated this week. The season’s lifeline format has added another layer of uncertainty to the eviction process. Contestants have two lifelines, and losing one can leave them with less room for error in subsequent rounds. A contestant who has no lifelines left faces eviction if they finish at the bottom again.
